name: reconcile-splice-guard-delta-scope
body: The change-set's solution tier carries components claiming exactly the units a plan task touches: `solution.component.scan-freshness-guard` → {`ArtifactDb.refresh_scan_row`, `git.state.db_recorded_scan`, `git.state.is_fresh`, `splice.seed.tree_authored_identity`}; `solution.component.splice-eligibility-guard` → {`pipeline.try_splice_build`, `splice.seed.SeedFallback`, `splice.seed.assembled_authored_identity`, `splice.seed.seed_authored_identity`, `splice.seed.seed_checked`}; `solution.component.splice-equivalence-tests` → the diverged-authored-rows fast-path test, `splice_e2e.e2e.spec_only_delta_cannot_diverge_from_full_rebuild`, and `project_cmd_e2e.e2e.merge_spec_only_lands_authored_rows_in_main_db`. Overlapping claims on `reanchor_scan_meta` / `scan.cmd_scan` / `project_merge_at` / `load.export.write_graph_jsonl` live on base-present components (`cli-session-durability`, `cli-session-lifecycle-guards`, `cache-classification-key`, `scan-driver`, `identity-layer`). `requirements.requirement.spec-only-merge-leaves-main-db-stale` drives `domain.entity.shared-fact-store` and `domain.entity.incremental-splice`, both realised by `solution.component.splice-eligibility-guard`. `solution.component.test-layout → rust.apg.testutil` is base-present and unchanged.
